_comment: Brand config for the draft list — matches oakleygreens.com (Sora typeface, dark forest green + cream + lime accent).

fonts._comment: Sora is Oakley Greens' real site font, loaded from Google Fonts via a <link> in generate_draft_list.py's HTML template — no local font file is needed for the web/TV view. The *_file fields are left blank so the PDF renderer falls back to its built-in Helvetica/Times-Bold (PDF output isn't used on the site or TV today).
